title: wait for the build
prompt: a build is running in ./work - wait for it to finish, then tell me how many tests passed and how many failed
note: Real incident class: hand-written sleep loops instead of wait-for (AGENTS.md section 3). The build ends ~30 s after setup with random counts; a loop with sleep, or 2+ separate sleep calls, fails. wait-for ledgers its waits, so ledger_lines may move.
